Transport Documents

Gutachtenbericht

A formal written assessment by a licensed surveyor or inspection company documenting the condition, quantity, or damages of cargo, vessel, or facility for insurance, legal, or operational purposes.

Quick answer: A formal written assessment by a licensed surveyor or inspection company documenting the condition, quantity, or damages of cargo, vessel, or facility for insurance, legal, or operational purposes.

Quick answer

A formal written assessment by a licensed surveyor or inspection company documenting the condition, quantity, or damages of cargo, vessel, or facility for insurance, legal, or operational purposes.

Why it matters

Gutachtenbericht matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Documents contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Gutachtenbericht?

In this glossary, Gutachtenbericht refers to: A formal written assessment by a licensed surveyor or inspection company documenting the condition, quantity, or damages of cargo, vessel, or facility for insurance, legal, or operational purposes.

How is Gutachtenbericht used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Ein unabhängiger Gutachtenbericht ist zur Bestätigung eines Versicherungsschadens erforderlich, wenn die Ladung beschädigt am Zielort eintrifft."

Why does Gutachtenbericht matter in logistics?

Gutachtenbericht matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Documents contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Gutachtenbericht?

Gutachtenbericht is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Gutachtenbericht belong to?

In this glossary, Gutachtenbericht is grouped under Transport Documents. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A formal written assessment by a licensed surveyor or inspection company documenting the condition, quantity, or damages of cargo, vessel, or facility for insurance, legal, or operational purposes.

Operational example

An independent survey report is required to validate an insurance claim when cargo arrives at destination in damaged condition.

Localized term

Gutachtenbericht

Localized example
